label: Unified Dei Filius route through all five typed senses, joint models, caused-is-not-infinite derived
summary: Follow-up to attempts 28296836 (#1483, lord and most blessed), 76bad0cb (#1492, immense and incomprehensible) and the living attempts 6683acc4, 38c1e7b1, 2663e73f. Each earlier batch gave the restated sufficiency 5fbea2f5 and the Dei Filius root c0f4a346 a route that typed some of the five primitives and kept the OLD bridge for the others, so each recorded strong_version_needed for the old bridges and 'joint satisfiability unresolved'. RESULTS (spec specs/dei-filius-unified-route.toml, all Comparator-verified). (1) Unified routes nineGiveDeiFiliusUnified (to 5fbea2f5) and deiFiliusRootUnified (to c0f4a346): every primitive passes through its typed sense and that sense's bridge at once, with none of the five old bridges (8d2ac441 intellect lives, bb3d4417 creator is lord, dc3ec456 perfect intellectual is most blessed, c7c32f20 creator is immense, fa3f08a8 infinite is incomprehensible). Living: the nine-restricted LIVING_2 premise 280770e3 (derived through the operation derivation of #1481: 8f93d9cc from 9c2a5dfe, 4728d5f4, 021aaa19, then STMT-SELF-OPERATING-UNMOVED-LIVES and STMT-NOTHING-MOVED-EXCEPT-AS-IN-POTENCY) and the restricted sense bridge ad49ea00; lord: 1063da3d and eb6611a5; blessed: 8f24379f and a23dd1ac; immense: 15df9d91 and 8bf775e9; incomprehensible: de92711c and 0042dd05. Both compose the registered nineGiveDeiFilius / deiFiliusRoot on primitives whose five fields are the antecedents of the old bridges (so those hold trivially and nothing about the given primitives is used). Exact premise list of the sufficiency route (15): 280770e3, ad49ea00, 1063da3d, eb6611a5, 8f24379f, a23dd1ac, 15df9d91, 8bf775e9, de92711c, 0042dd05, STMT-INFINITE-ACT-HAS-INFINITE-POWER, e919fe2e, 8d73ef90, STMT-GOODNESS-IS-ACTUALITY, STMT-MATTER-FORM-AND-ESSE-ESSENCE-ARE-COMPOSITIONS. The root route takes the 22 spine-root premises (EM included) and the first eleven of these. sense_bridges list LIVING, LORD, BLESSED, IMMENSE, INCOMPREHENSIBLE (and GOD for the root). Only weak versions are used: corpus.py check reports no strong-version warning for these arguments apart from the corpus-wide EM pattern (ee4ab504, 277 arguments). (2) 18ca6f9d derived (causedIsNotInfiniteFromReception) from four EXISTING open premises: b7d4eede (caused in being by something distinct is a creature, bare), 29e71e43 (a creature's esse is received in some principle, supported by a q.7 a.2 reading), 7de89edb (received esse is limited, supported) and 965d0e26 (INFINITE_1 esse is not limited, supported, q.7 a.1). No new bridge was needed: the step from external cause of esse to received esse, which DISAMB-ESSE-RECEPTION keeps apart, is carried by two explicit premises through Creature, not by identifying the senses. The scope condition of 18ca6f9d (definition 80dea550: elements of Being individuated by their act of being) binds b7d4eede the same way: with the processions as instances it would make the Son a creature. Computed: 18ca6f9d moves bare to closed (closed by a verified derivation from four open premises; not established); open premises reaching the root 455 to 454 (bare 316 to 315); two support alternatives added; no bare premise added. (3) Joint satisfiability, previously unresolved, resolved for both unified routes (controls, result of argument bf0e2111). Model 1 (Bool): true has the nine; false is a caused intellect, composite, in potency to and moved in understanding, not infinite, a creature with received and limited esse; every premise of the sufficiency route and every open leaf under its nine-statements (9c2a5dfe, 4728d5f4, 021aaa19, 38aa1327, 4be9a4ac, 123d394b, 4f36f332, the four reception premises, bbac932e) and 18ca6f9d hold; true has every Dei Filius attribute; the old bridge 8d2ac441 fails there. Model 2: the four roles of the spine root's full25 fixture (NecessaryClassicalGodRootControl) with ONE change, every essence mapped to source; given EM, all 22 spine-root premises, the eleven Dei Filius premises and the same leaves hold, and the selected root source has every Dei Filius attribute. Finding: the unchanged full25 fixture is NOT a model of the unified root bundle: its supporter and recipient have esse equal to essence, so the root premise SubsistentBeingIsInfiniteReading makes them INFINITE_1, while source causes their being, so 18ca6f9d fails (control part 3). In general, within the unified root bundle the infinity premise and 18ca6f9d together entail that whatever has its being caused by another being distinct from it has (represented) esse distinct from essence (lake-checked lemma causedHasDistinctEsse, not registered), and then by the q.3 a.7 kinds premise is composite: a consequence of the joint bundle, not of either premise alone. Model 2 is degenerate in one respect stated plainly: on the old all-true act dictionary every role is pure act and universally perfect, so the recipient is also BLESSED_2 and LIVING_1 there; every creature's esse is received in the divine essence (every essence is source), and the roles with limited esse are universally perfect, so EsseLimited is not tied to perfection there; it witnesses joint satisfiability only. The controls result permits the three Mathlib axioms because it reuses NecessaryClassicalGodRootControl.checks (propext); the routes and the 18ca6f9d derivation are zero-axiom. (4) strong_version_needed notes on the lord/blessed and immense/incomprehensible routes now point to the unified route instead of calling it an open next step; those routes keep the strong versions because their Challenges are frozen. OBJECTION AUDIT (substantive objection standard, applied both ways). The unified routes add no premise; every premise and its audit is as recorded in the earlier attempts (the existential-inertia objection to 8bf775e9 stays, owned by the conservation work). The joint models are not evidence for any premise: they show only that each bundle is jointly satisfiable in the stated formal semantics, which removes the specific worry that combining the typed senses makes a route vacuous; they do not touch premise truth. Newly load-bearing on the root route through 18ca6f9d: b7d4eede (caused by another is a creature): the only mechanism on file is the Trinitarian scope point (read without the stipulation it would make the Son a creature), answered by the individuation stipulation, now linked on b7d4eede itself (definition 80dea550 and its paraphrase), since Round2PerfectionPrimacy also uses it; DISAMB-ESSE-RECEPTION now names the premise pair b7d4eede + 29e71e43 as the explicit passage from external cause to reception; DEF-CREATURE is read as 'ordered to a cause of its being', so the premise is close to that definition; no substantive objection identified. 29e71e43 (every creature's esse is received in some principle): this is where the weight now sits, the general reception of creaturely esse in a receiving principle. It does not say the principle is the creature's own essence (that is the separate STMT-ESSE-RECEIVED-IN-OWN-ESSENCE), and DEF-ESSE-RECEIVED-IN leaves the real constitution of the principle open. Its q.7 a.2 support covers only the narrower sense of creature (things made by God, DEF-CREATURE); b7d4eede reads Creature broadly (ordered to some cause of its being, secondary causes included), and the chain needs that broad extension (recorded on DEF-CREATURE and 29e71e43). Unread lead, no evidential weight: the tradition denying a real distinction of esse and essence in creatures (Scotus, Ockham, later scholastic and modern metaphysics), with Suarez (Disputationes metaphysicae 31) as the lead text; it would target 29e71e43 if EsseReceivedIn requires a really distinct receiving principle (DEF-ESSE-RECEIVED-IN reads it as a principle standing as receiving potency to received act); it is not read in the corpus, so no mechanism is justified here; note that it would reject this route to finitude, not the finitude of creatures. 7de89edb: unread lead, no evidential weight: ST III q.17 a.2 (the eternal esse of the Word is the esse of Christ's humanity); on readings where the humanity 'receives' uncreated esse, a received esse would be unlimited. Candidate reply: the humanity is not a limiting receiving potency for that esse, and under the individuation stipulation (80dea550) it is not a separate element of Being with its own esse. Not a defeat; no substantive objection identified. 965d0e26: no substantive objection identified (965d0e26 is close to the INFINITE_1 gloss, 'not received in and limited by anything'). The open united-soul case of DISAMB-ESSE-RECEPTION (a subsisting form communicating its esse to matter) bears on STMT-ESSE-RECEIVED-IN-OWN-ESSENCE, not on these four. WARRANT AUDIT: no claim states any premise of either route or of the derivation; three of the four reception premises are supported by q.7 a.1-2 readings with recorded gaps (generalization from a subsistent created form to every creature or every received esse). No premise is established.
blocker: Not blocked. Next tests: (0) read Suarez DM 31 (or the corpus's real-distinction sources) to decide whether the Suarezian denial is a substantive objection to 29e71e43 under DEF-ESSE-RECEIVED-IN, or only to a stronger really-distinct reading; (1) derive b7d4eede or restate it as the definitional unfolding of DEF-CREATURE if Creature is defined rather than primitive; (2) a non-degenerate root model (act not everywhere true, a creature in potency) so the root bundle's joint satisfiability does not rest on the all-true act dictionary; (3) derive bbac932e from a typed measure of knowability (open test (3) of 76bad0cb); (4) record the joint-bundle consequence 'caused as to being implies esse distinct from essence' as its own checked lemma if a later argument needs it.
